title: Classic Grilled Cheeseburgers with Potato Wedges

actions.body: {amt:potato_russet} of russet potatoes (skin on) into 8 wedges each and toss them with {amt:oil_neutral:0.75} of oil, {amt:garlic_powder} of garlic powder, {amt:paprika_smoked} of smoked paprika, {amt:salt_kosher:0.25} of salt and {amt:pepper_black:0.25} of pepper.
the wedges in a single layer on a double sheet of heavy-duty foil and crimp the edges into a tightly sealed packet.

{amt:ground_beef} of ground beef into 4 loose patties about ¾ inch thick and a little wider than the buns, without overworking the meat. Press a shallow dimple into the centre of each so they stay flat as they cook, then keep them chilled.

the wedges: open the packet (watch the steam) and tip them straight onto the grates over the hot side for 2–3 minutes per side until charred and crisp, then move them back to the cooler side to stay warm.
the patties on both sides with the remaining {amt:salt_kosher:0.75} of salt and {amt:pepper_black:0.75} of pepper right before they go on.
the patties over the hot side with the lid closed until well browned and they release easily, then flip once. Don't press them with the spatula.
{amt:cheddar} of sliced cheddar over the patties after another 3 minutes, close the lid and cook until the cheese melts and the burgers read 160°F in the centre.
{amt:bun_burger|bun|buns}, cut side down, over the cooler side for 30–60 seconds while the burgers rest for a couple of minutes.
the burgers: spread the buns with {amt:ketchup} of ketchup and {amt:mustard_dijon} of mustard, then layer lettuce, a cheeseburger, tomato, onion and pickles. Serve with the potato wedges.

that the thickest piece reads at least 165°F; thighs stay juicy right up to 175°F. Rest them for 5 minutes.
the chicken with the corn salad and the remaining {amt:bbq_sauce:0.333} of BBQ sauce for dipping.

{amt:butter_unsalted} of softened butter with {amt:garlic_head} of finely minced garlic, {amt:parsley_fresh} of chopped parsley, {amt:thyme_fresh} of thyme leaves and {amt:salt_kosher:0.1} of salt.

the potatoes, let them steam dry for a few minutes, then toss with {amt:olive_oil_evoo:0.75} of olive oil and {amt:pepper_black:0.5} of pepper.

the steak over the hottest part with the lid closed until deeply browned, then flip once and cook the second side until it reads 130–135°F for medium-rare (140–145°F for medium).

title: Hawaiian Grilled Teriyaki Chicken with Pineapple and Rice

the chicken for 5 minutes, then slice it.
over the rice with the pineapple, the rest of the glaze, {amt:scallion|scallion|scallions}, thinly sliced, and {amt:sesame_seed} of sesame seeds.

the chicken over direct heat with the lid closed until well marked, then flip once and cook until it reads 165°F in the thickest part. Rest it for 5 minutes.
